title.en: Diesel 60 and LZ-60 share a code and not a pipe cell
title.zh: 柴油60和 LZ-60 共用代号，不共用管径格

description.en: Both pages print HBT60-13.132. LZ-60 prints delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm and engine 6105 / 145 kW. Diesel 60 prints engine 6105 / 144 kW and no pipe diameter.
description.zh: 两页都印 HBT60-13.132。LZ-60 印输送管 100 / 125 mm，发动机 6105 / 145 kW。柴油60印发动机 6105 / 144 kW，没有管径。

h1.en: Diesel 60 and LZ-60, same printed code
h1.zh: 柴油60与 LZ-60，相同的印出代号

directAnswer.en: Diesel 60 Concrete Pump and LZ-60 Diesel Concrete Pump are two Xingtai pages that both print HBT60-13.132. Only LZ-60 prints delivery pipe inner diameter 100 / 125 mm. The engine kilowatts are 144 on Diesel 60 and 145 on LZ-60. Neither page prints a piston or seal size.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油60型混凝土泵和 LZ-60柴油混凝土泵是邢台的两张页面，都印了 HBT60-13.132。只有 LZ-60 印了输送管内径 100 / 125 mm。柴油60的发动机千瓦是 144，LZ-60 是 145。两页都没有印活塞或密封尺寸。

body.en: Model Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132. Diesel engine 6105 / 144 kW. Output 35 m³/h. Maximum outlet pressure 30 MPa. Hopper 0.4 m³. Pumping distance 150 m / 350 m. Hydraulic pump Kawasaki double pump 100. Size 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm. Weight 3500 kg. Aggregate size is not printed. Delivery pipe diameter is not printed.
body.zh: 型号 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132。柴油机 6105 / 144 kW。输送量 35 m³/h。最大出口压力 30 MPa。料斗 0.4 m³。输送距离 150 m / 350 m。液压泵为川崎双泵 100。外形 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm。重量 3500 kg。骨料粒径没有印。输送管内径没有印。

body.en: Model LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132. Engine 6105 / 145 kW. Output 50 m³/h. Pumping pressure 35 MPa. Conveying distance 100 m. Delivery height 300 m. Aggregate 4 cm and below. Delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm. Size 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. Weight 5500 kg. The 100 m cell is distance. The pipe cell is 100 / 125 mm.
body.zh: 型号 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132。发动机 6105 / 145 kW。输送量 50 m³/h。泵送压力 35 MPa。输送距离 100 m。输送高度 300 m。骨料 4 cm 及以下。输送管 100 / 125 mm。外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。重量 5500 kg。100 m 那一格是距离。管径格是 100 / 125 mm。

heading.en: What a spare inquiry can say

body.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Use 100 / 125 mm only with the LZ-60 page. For Diesel 60, leave the pipe diameter blank. The Kawasaki double pump 100 cell is not a published spare page.
body.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 只有对照 LZ-60 那一页时才使用 100 / 125 mm。柴油60的管径留空。川崎双泵 100 那一格不是已公布的配件页。

question.en: Are 144 kW and 145 kW the same cell?
question.zh: 144 kW 和 145 kW 是同一格吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 60 prints 6105 / 144 kW. LZ-60 prints 6105 / 145 kW.
No. Aggregate size is a missing field on the Diesel 60 page. LZ-60 prints 4 cm and below.
answer.zh: 没有。骨料粒径在柴油60页面是缺字段。LZ-60 印的是 4 cm 及以下。

question.en: Is a piston size printed on either page?

answer.en: No. Piston outer diameter is a missing field on both model pages.
answer.zh: 没有。活塞外径在两张型号页上都是缺字段。

answer.en: A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank.
answer.zh: 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。

label.zh: 邮件或 WhatsApp 联系邢台工厂
